name: Gene-Warped Warwolf
desc: This warwolf was given incalculable strength through horrific genetic manipulation. Its gentle nature was completely wiped out, and it now lives only to unleash destruction.

name: Frostosaurus
desc: This monster's metabolism enables it to endure long periods of cold, harnessing the power to become a creature of solid ice! Nothing else can withstand such temperatures, especially victims of its glacial rampage.

name: Spiral Serpent
desc: When huge whirlpools lay cities asunder, it is the hunger of this sea serpent at work. No one has ever escaped its dreaded Spiral Wave to accurately describe the terror they experienced.

name: Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird
desc: Once per turn: You can gain 500 LP for each card in your opponent's hand.

name: Neo-Spacian Grand Mole
desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can return both the opponent's monster and this card to the hand.

name: Neo-Spacian Glow Moss
desc:
If this card attacks or is attacked: Your opponent draws 1 card and shows it, then, based on its type apply this effect.
● Monster: End the Battle Phase of this turn.
● Spell: If this card is attacking, you can change it to a direct attack instead.
● Trap: Change this card to Defense Position.

name: The Six Samurai - Yaichi
desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap Card; destroy that target. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. This card cannot declare an attack during the turn this effect is activated. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

name: The Six Samurai - Kamon
desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card; destroy that target. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. This card cannot declare an attack during the turn this effect is activated. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

name: The Six Samurai - Yariza
desc: While you control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

name: The Six Samurai - Nisashi
desc: While you control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name, this card can attack twice during each Battle Phase. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

name: The Six Samurai - Zanji
desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: Destroy the monster this card attacked. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

name: The Six Samurai - Irou
desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

name: Great Shogun Shien
desc: If you control 2 or more face-up "Six Samurai" monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Your opponent can only activate 1 Spell/Trap Card each turn. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy a face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

name: Shien's Footsoldier
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Six Samurai" monster from your Deck.

name: Sage of Silence
desc: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards during the next turn.

name: Sage of Stillness
desc: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the next turn.

name: Reign-Beaux, Overlord of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls OR all Spell/Trap Cards they control.

name: Kahkki, Guerilla of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Gren, Tactician of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Fusion Devourer
desc: When this card battles a Fusion Monster, the ATK of the Fusion Monster becomes 0 during the Damage Step only.

name: Electric Virus
desc: You can discard this card to the Graveyard, then target 1 Machine or Dragon-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: Puppet Plant
desc: You can discard this card to the Graveyard, then target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: Marionette Mite
desc: You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 Fiend or Zombie monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: D.D. Crow
desc: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

name: Silent Abyss
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-WATER monsters.

name: Firestorm Prominence
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-FIRE monsters.

name: Raging Earth
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-EARTH monsters.

name: Destruction Cyclone
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-WIND monsters.

name: Radiant Spirit
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-LIGHT monsters.

name: Umbral Soul
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-DARK monsters.

name: Alien Psychic
desc: This card is changed to Defense Position when it is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned. Monsters with A-Counters cannot declare an attack.

name: Lycanthrope
desc: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Synthesis Spell". When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each Normal Monster in your Graveyard.

name: Cu Chulainn the Awakened
desc: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, Emblem of the Awakening. Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard. This card gains ATK equal to that Normal Monster's ATK, until the Standby Phase of your next turn.

name: Elemental HERO Air Neos
desc:
"Elemental Hero Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird"
This card can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by returning the above cards you control to the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) While your Life Points are lower than your opponent's, this card gains ATK equal to the difference. This card returns to the Extra Deck during the End Phase.

name: Elemental HERO Grand Neos
desc:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand. During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck.

name: Elemental HERO Glow Neos
desc:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy that target, then apply the effect based on its type. ● Monster: This card cannot attack this turn. ● Spell: This card can attack your opponent directly this turn. ● Trap: Change this card to Defense Position.

name: Ancient Rules
desc: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your hand.

name: Dark World Dealings
desc: Each player draws 1 card, then each player discards 1 card.

name: Neos Force
desc: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Neos". It gains 800 ATK. When it destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard. During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

name: Legendary Ebon Steed
desc: Equip only to a "Six Samurai" monster. It gains 200 ATK and DEF. If it would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.

name: "A" Cell Scatter Burst
desc: Select 1 face-up "Alien" monster you control. Destroy it and distribute new A-Counters equal to its Level among your opponent's face-up monsters.

name: Twister
desc: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Synthesis Spell
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Lycanthrope". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Emblem of the Awakening
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Cu Chulainn the Awakened". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 4 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Advanced Ritual Art
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon any 1 Ritual Monster. You must also send Normal Monsters from your Deck to the GY whose total Levels equal the Level of that Ritual Monster.

name: Card Trader
desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck; draw 1 card.

name: Shien's Castle of Mist
desc: When a "Six Samurai" monster is attacked, the attacking monster loses 500 ATK during damage calculation only.

name: Skyscraper 2 - Hero City
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card: You can target 1 "Elemental HERO" monster in your Graveyard that was destroyed by battle; Special Summon that target.

name: Change of Hero - Reflector Ray
desc: When an "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 300.

name: Hero Medal
desc: When this Set card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, shuffle this card into its owner's Deck. Then draw 1 card.

name: Return of the Six Samurai
desc: Target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. Destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

name: Eliminating the League
desc: Discard 1 Spell, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, then look at your opponent's hand and send all cards in their hand with the same name as that destroyed card to the GY.

name: Flashbang
desc: Activate only after damage calculation when a monster your opponent controls made a direct attack. It is now the End Phase of this turn.

name: The Transmigration Prophecy
desc: Target 2 cards in the GY(s); shuffle those targets into the Deck(s).

name: Anti-Fusion Device
desc: Destroy 1 face-up Fusion Monster on the field.

name: Ritual Sealing
desc: Destroy 1 face-up Ritual Monster on the field.

name: Birthright
desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

name: Swift Samurai Storm!
desc: Each turn, after the first time a "Six Samurai" monster you control battles, all "Six Samurai" monsters you control gain 300 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Cloak and Dagger
desc: Declare 1 Monster Card name. If your opponent Normal Summons, Special Summons, or flips that monster(s) face-up, remove that monster(s) and this card from play.

name: Pulling the Rug
desc: Negate the activation and effect of an Effect Monster whose effect activated when a monster was Normal Summoned (even itself), and destroy that Effect Monster.
